_huong_dan: Dan phan 'rules' ben duoi vao Firebase Console > Realtime Database > Rules > Publish.
UID cua vo da duoc dien san, khong can sua gi.
1. Chi UID 7ePgCPmzxHdEAEazHo9IkyKf2rw2 moi doc/ghi duoc crmData.
Nguoi khac du co tai khoan Firebase hop le van bi tu choi hoan toan.
2. Ghi nhat ky dang nhap vao authLog: BAT KY tai khoan nao dang nhap qua app
deu bi ghi lai (de bat duoc ke la), nhung CHI vo moi doc duoc nhat ky do.
3. Nhat ky khong the sua hay xoa boi nguoi khac - chi tao moi. Ke dot nhap
khong the xoa dau vet cua chinh minh.
MCP server khong bi anh huong: no dung service account, quyen admin, bo qua rules.
NHO LAM THEM: Console > Authentication > Settings > User actions >
TAT 'Enable create (sign-up)'. Neu khong, nguoi la van tu tao tai khoan duoc
(ho khong doc duoc du lieu, nhung chan ngay tu dau van hon).
Ghi chu ky thuat (truoc day de nham BEN TRONG khoi rules -> Firebase bao loi cu phap):
- crmData/leads/.indexOn ownerUid: de sau nay loc lead theo tung nguoi dung khong bi cham.
- appConfig: chua khoa ket noi MCP do app tu sinh, chi chu tai khoan doc/ghi duoc.
- authLog: ai dang nhap cung ghi duoc mot dong moi (de bat ke la), nhung khong ai sua/xoa duoc dong da co, va chi chu tai khoan doc duoc.
CA FILE NAY gio dan thang vao Console duoc: Firebase bo qua khoa _huong_dan o ngoai khoi rules.
